annotations.title: Rename a job type or change its availability

description:
Rename a job type or change its availability

Edits a catalog entry in place. A rename applies to NEW bookings only: every job stores the job-type name it was booked with, so existing and completed jobs keep their original label.

Partial update: omit a field to keep it. `name` rejects "" because a type must stay identifiable, and must stay unique (JOB_TYPE_DUPLICATE). Setting `status` to inactive is the reversible way to take a type off the booking form; inactive types are refused for new job requests.

Default quote bundle: default_duration_minutes / default_mobilization_minutes / default_demobilization_minutes follow the same partial rule; omit to keep, 0 to clear, a value to set. Clearing the duration while a buffer stays is refused (JOB_TYPE_INVALID_DEFAULT_DURATION).

Rows the platform ships with (`is_system=true`, e.g. the default "General" type) keep their name and status read-only (JOB_TYPE_SYSTEM_READ_ONLY); their default quote bundle IS editable. Create your own type if you need different wording.

default_demobilization_minutes.description: Default demobilization (teardown) minutes, 0–1440; used together with the default duration. Requires a default duration. Omit = keep, 0 = clear.

default_duration_minutes.description: Default hands-on work duration in minutes for this kind of work (1–20160). A quote that sends no job_duration_minutes uses it, which is what lets an automation or voice agent schedule a job without knowing how long the work takes. Omit = keep, 0 = clear.

default_mobilization_minutes.description: Default mobilization (setup/travel-prep) minutes, 0–1440; used together with the default duration. Requires a default duration. Omit = keep, 0 = clear.

name.description: nil = keep; min=1 rejects an explicit "".
